topics.buyerQuestion: What should a buyer prepare before requesting a custom paper bag packaging quote?
topics.answer: For custom paper bags, buyers should prepare bag dimensions, handle style, paper weight direction, printing area, quantity range, target market and whether the bag is for retail, gift, event, ecommerce or boutique use.
checklist: Bag width, height and gusset size
Handle type: twisted paper, rope, ribbon, die-cut, cotton or undecided
Paper weight direction and finish reference
Outside print, inside print, logo position and artwork status
Use case: retail shopping bag, gift bag, event bag, ecommerce insert bag or boutique packaging

topics.buyerQuestion: What should a buyer clarify before sourcing PVC or PET clear box packaging?
topics.answer: For PVC or PET clear boxes, buyers should clarify product fit, display window requirement, thickness direction, closure style, printing area, scratch risk, retail display use and whether the product needs an insert or tray.
checklist: Product size and packed product weight
Material preference: PVC, PET, PP or supplier review needed
Clear display area, frosting or printed coverage
Box closure style and hanging hole requirement
Retail channel, product category and scratch-protection expectation

topics.buyerQuestion: What should a buyer prepare before asking for a folding gift box supplier quote?
topics.answer: For folding gift boxes, buyers should prepare internal dimensions, product weight, folding structure direction, insert needs, surface finish, print coverage, target sales channel and whether the box must balance shipping efficiency with premium presentation.
checklist: Folding structure reference or desired opening style
Insert, sleeve, divider or tray requirement
Finish direction: matte, textured, foil, spot UV, soft touch or undecided
Retail, gift set, ecommerce or sample-kit usage
